market.question: Will the highest temperature in London be 15°C on May 6?

assessment.reasoning: London is in a May heatwave with Met Office reporting ~27°C in London on May 5 and ~22°C on May 6. The 15°C bucket is roughly 7°C below forecast — very unlikely. Climatology has ~15.6°C average but current synoptic pattern is much warmer.
data_sources: Heart UK May Bank holiday forecast
assessment.key_uncertainty: Cold front timing could drop temps but forecast shows warmth holding
